name: bg-soft-a
prompt: Abstract editorial poster background for a web page, on pure bright white. NO people, no faces, no hands, no text. Rendered entirely in soft airbrush spray paint, like a risograph gig poster: shapes have NO hard outlines and NO line art; every edge dissolves into soft speckled spray, colour is dense in the middle of a shape and fades into fine grain at its edges, and the whole image carries visible risograph grain. Composition, all on the left and along the bottom: a navy blue sprayed band rising from the bottom-left, with a soft white zig-zag gap through it; a golden yellow sprayed sun glowing out of the top-left corner; a red hibiscus flower (bunga raya), about one sixth of the canvas width, at the upper middle-left, its five petals made of soft red spray with a glowing golden yellow stamen and no outlines; a soft red sprayed arc sweeping along the bottom edge. The centre and the whole right half stay empty pure white.
style: Use ONLY navy blue #024B8F, red #DA332B, golden yellow #FEDD1B and pure white #FFFFFF. No cream, no beige, no peach, no orange, no pink, no brown. Soft, dreamy, airbrushed, grainy, but high resolution. No crescent, no star.

name: bg-soft-b

name: logo-3d-cartoon-row
prompt: A 3D animated-film cartoon logo, like a character render from a modern animated feature: three friendly heads, each shaped as a rounded CUBE with soft bevelled edges, smooth stylised skin with gentle subsurface glow, big expressive eyes with bright highlights, small simple noses, warm open smiles, and sculpted stylised hair. One Malay man, one Chinese man and one Indian man, all young men, natural skin tones, different short hairstyles, clearly male. The three cube heads sit side by side at slightly different heights, gently touching, the middle one a little forward. Soft cinematic studio lighting. Heads only, no necks, no bodies, no clothing, no accessories, no costume.
style: Isolated on a completely plain pure white background, no floor, no ground shadow, no backdrop, no frame. Small colour accents only in navy #024B8F, red #DA332B and golden yellow #FEDD1B. Respectful, warm, appealing, no caricature. No text, no symbols, no crescent, no star.
